authPanel.heading: Your clients, quotes and renewals in one place.
authPanel.body: Built for insurance agents in Kenya: send branded quotes from your phone, see when clients open them, and never miss a renewal.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.invalid: That email and password do not match. Check them and try again.
signIn.unverified: Confirm your email first. We sent a link to {email}.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.checkInbox: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it on this device to continue.
signUp.exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.

twoFactor.title: Two-step sign-in
twoFactor.body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.invalid: That code is not valid. Codes change every 30 seconds; try the current one.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter your email and we will send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalid: This reset link has expired. Ask for a new one.

verify.title: Email confirmed
verify.body: Your email is confirmed. Set up your agency to get started.
verify.failed: Confirmation links expire after a while. Sign in and we will send a new one.

invitation.title: Join an agency
invitation.signedOut: Sign in or create an account with the email address the invitation was sent to.
invitation.failed: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask the agency to send a new one.

onboarding.agencyNameHint: As clients know you, e.g. Wanjiku Insurance Agency.
onboarding.detailsBody: These appear on your quotes and receipts. You can change them later in Settings.
onboarding.brandBody: Pick a look for your documents. This is how clients see your quotes.
onboarding.pickExisting: Continue with an agency you belong to

nav.noNotifications: Nothing new. You will see here when clients open what you share.

home.body: Your agency is set up. Next, add your branches, invite your team and check how your documents look.

members.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? They lose access straight away.

numbering.body: How quotes, invoices and receipts are numbered. Numbers are given when a document is issued, never skipped.
numbering.patternHint: Use '{YYYY}' for the year, '{YY}', '{MM}' for the month, '{BRANCH}' for the branch code and '{SEQ:5}' for the number (5 digits).

branding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 1 MB.
branding.footerHint: e.g. your IRA licence line. Shown at the bottom of every document.

security.twoFactorBody: Optional. Adds a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator) when you sign in.
security.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
security.backupCodes: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your phone.
